app.title: Absor Connect
app.welcomeDescription: Connect to S3-compatible storage or SSH servers, organize your connections, and drag & drop files between your computer and your remote servers.

settings.title: Settings
settings.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
settings.errorCodeSign: The automatic update could not be applied because the app is not code-signed. Please download the new version manually from GitHub.
settings.themeHint: Switch between light and dark mode
settings.importError: Import error: the file does not have a valid format.
settings.exportWarning: The exported file contains your credentials (access keys, passwords and passphrases) unencrypted. Keep it in a safe place. When importing, current connections will be replaced.

sidebar.title: Connections
sidebar.noConnectionsHint: Click + to add an S3 or SSH connection.

local.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
local.confirmDeleteMultiple: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} items?

s3.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
s3.confirmDeleteMultiple: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} items?

sftp.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Folders are deleted with all their contents.
sftp.confirmDeleteMultiple: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} items? Folders are deleted with all their contents.
sftp.failedToConnect: Could not connect to the server

errors.SSH_AUTH_FAILED: Authentication failed: the server rejected the username, password or key.
errors.SSH_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the server. Check the host and port.
errors.SSH_TIMEOUT: The server did not respond in time.
errors.SSH_CONNECTION_LOST: The connection to the server was lost.
errors.SSH_KEY_UNREADABLE: Could not read the private key ({{detail}}).
errors.SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE: The private key needs a passphrase, or the passphrase is incorrect.
errors.SFTP_NOT_FOUND: The file or folder no longer exists on the server.

terminal.connectionLost: The connection to the server was lost.

store.credentialsUnavailable: The saved credentials for this connection cannot be read. Edit it and enter them again.
store.unreadableCredentials: The credentials of {{count}} connection(s) are not available: they could not be read on the computer they were uploaded from, or the service cannot decrypt them. They are kept: edit those connections to enter them again.
store.corruptRecovered: The connections file was damaged and could not be read. A copy was kept at: {{path}}
store.reenterCredentials: The saved credentials cannot be read. Enter them again, or leave them empty to keep the saved ones.
store.encryptionUnavailable: This system has no secure storage available (for example, Linux without a keyring): your account session is stored unencrypted on this computer.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to have your connections on all your computers.
auth.expired: Your session has expired or was closed elsewhere. Please sign in again.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.email_taken: An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.connections_conflict: Another computer saved changes in the meantime.
errors.connections_invalid: The service rejected the connection list.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the service. Check your internet connection.
errors.server_error: The service is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach the service
unreachable.description: Absor Connect keeps your connections in your account. Check your internet connection and try again.

migration.title: Connections on this computer
migration.description_one: There is 1 connection saved on this computer by a previous version. Do you want to upload it to your account? It will then be removed from this computer.
migration.description_other: There are {{count}} connections saved on this computer by a previous version. Do you want to upload them to your account? They will then be removed from this computer.
migration.failed: The migration could not be completed: {{reason}} Your connections are still on this computer and you will be asked again the next time you sign in.
migration.done: Connections uploaded to your account and removed from this computer.

cloud.conflict: Another computer changed your connections. The current list has been loaded and your last change was not saved: please repeat it.
cloud.saveFailed: The change could not be saved: {{reason}}

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your sessions on other computers have been closed.
account.deleteWarning: Your account and all your saved connections will be deleted, on all your computers. This cannot be undone.
